Exhibit 99.16

 

Notice to ASX

 

 

Rio Tinto’s Iron Ore Investor Site Visit

 

18 June 2018

 

Rio Tinto is hosting a site visit to its Pilbara iron ore operations from 18-21 June 2018.

 

The presentation slides are attached and will also be made available at www.riotinto.com/presentations.

 

The Day 1 presentations will be webcast live starting at 3.00 pm (AEST) and can be accessed at www.riotinto.com/webcast.

 

A replay of the webcast will be available on the Rio Tinto website following the event at www.riotinto.com/webcast.
